description: Follow-up build for an AppKit app after the initial parallel build (waves 0-4, omitted here). Wave 5 fixes known compile errors in parallel; waves 6-7 converge sequentially until the app and its post-deploy job are stable; wave 8 converges the ops dashboard and validates both bundles; wave 9 converges the Genie space over the app's metric views.

ignore_patterns: App did not respect SIGTERM timeout

ops_genie_space.name: [dev your_name] My App Ops Genie
probe_questions: How many deployments were there last week?
What is the error rate by day?

waves.name: Known compile fixes (parallel, static gate)
gate: No file outside each session's owned_paths changed

sessions.title: Fix type errors in paper engine and routes
sessions.scope: Fix the TS2554/TS2345/TS2365/TS18047 errors listed in the plan's Known issues. No suppressions.
sessions.context_notes: From the interactive session: errors seen in deployment 01f1... BUILD logs; re-verify line numbers against the current code.

sessions.title: Type external API responses
sessions.scope: Replace untyped `unknown` response handling with validated types in the market data services.

waves.name: Converge: app builds, starts and stays up
gate: Session 16 status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Deploy app, read OTel logs, fix until stable
sessions.scope: Deploy the app to dev, diagnose deployment status and OTel logs for the new deployment, fix the code and config within owned_paths, and repeat until the app is RUNNING with no error log lines and the startup marker present.

waves.name: Converge: post-deploy job succeeds against the running app

sessions.title: Run post-deploy setup job, fix until it succeeds
sessions.scope: Run the post-deploy setup job, diagnose failures from the run output, fix within owned_paths, and repeat until it succeeds. The app must still be stable afterwards.

waves.name: Converge: ops dashboard publishes and every dataset resolves
gate: Session 18 status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Deploy ops dashboard, EXPLAIN every dataset, fix until clean
sessions.scope: Deploy the bundle so the ops dashboard publishes, run EXPLAIN on every dataset query on its warehouse, fix broken queries or table references in the dashboard JSON, and repeat until every dataset resolves.

waves.name: Converge: Genie space resolves against the current metric views
gate: Session 19 status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Deploy Genie space, check tables, column configs and example SQL, fix until clean
sessions.scope: Deploy the bundle so the Genie space is written, check that every table and metric view resolves, every column config matches a current column, and every example SQL passes EXPLAIN on the space's warehouse; fix the space definition and repeat until clean.
